names.title: Name generator
names.body: Batches of 10 explained names, with acronyms for associations, a score and domain (.com, .org, .gn, .africa…) and social handle checks.

logos.title: Logo generator and editor
logos.body: 8 vector proposals per batch shown in context, then an editor to adjust font, colours, icon and layout. SVG, PNG, PDF export and app icon pack.

signatures.title: Signatures

kit.title: Brand kit
kit.body: A shareable page, an automatically generated PDF brand guide and a tidy ZIP archive.

pricing.provisional: Provisional prices, subject to change before launch.

faq.q1: Can I pay with Orange Money?
faq.a1: Yes, Orange Money is our primary payment method. You confirm the payment on your phone.
faq.a3: On purchase, commercial usage rights are assigned to you and the logo becomes exclusive. We recommend registering the trademark with OAPI.
faq.q4: How do I get association pricing?
faq.a4: Upload your registration proof from the Billing page; an administrator validates it.

names.title: An available name
names.body: Batches of 10 explained names, with acronym, score and domain and social handle checks.

logos.title: A vector logo
logos.body: 8 proposals per batch, an editor to adjust everything, and every version: color, white, black, app icon.

studio.title: The design studio
studio.body: Posts, stories, flyers, posters, business cards and presentations, composed in your colors with your logo.

signatures.title: Signatures and stamp
signatures.body: Slogan, Gmail- and Outlook-ready email signature, handwritten signature and a stamp ready to be made.

kit.title: A brand kit
kit.body: PDF brand guidelines, a tidy archive and a password-protected share page.

studio.title: A studio that knows your brand
studio.body: No blank page: your colors, logo and fonts are already there. Each template composes itself for the chosen format, and each design is checked before it goes to the printer or social media.

templates.title: On-brand templates
templates.body: Announcements, promotions, events, carousels, business cards: composed with your logo, colors and fonts.

resize.title: Magic resize
resize.body: A post becomes a story, an A5 flyer or a LinkedIn banner: the layout recomposes instead of stretching.

check.title: Quality check
check.body: Text contrast, minimum size, safe area, bleed, photo resolution, off-brand colors — fixed in one click.

print.title: Printer-ready
print.body: Actual-size PDF with bleed, trim box and crop marks; outlined text.

variations.title: One-click variations
variations.body: Swapped palette, inverted background, color harmonies, other fonts, mirrored layout: eight on-brand directions.

library.title: A real toolbox
library.body: 1,890 icons, 85 fonts (38 for jerseys and sports), gradients, shadows, curved text, photo masks, layers, eyedropper and keyboard shortcuts.
